cohort: Women from the 2009-2010 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) who completed both Bowel Health and Female Reproductive Health Questionnaires
finding: While post-menopausal women experience higher rates of chronic constipation and diarrhea compared to pre-menopausal women, this difference was not associated with menopause or other women's health factors.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with chronic diarrhea in univariate analysis of post-menopausal women.
